title: [T001] Local service and owner permissions
body:
# T001 — Local service and owner permissions

Status: READY
Dependencies: none

## Goal

Create a durable local service boundary for UI/MCP clients. Separate model-facing requests from owner approval and key access. Preserve signed asset IDs and original attribution.

## Edit boundaries

* `src/dscc/service.py`
* `src/dscc/ipc.py`
* `tests/test_service.py`

Coordinate any shared-core or protocol change through an ADR.

## Acceptance

Two clients see the same assets; invalid client credentials and origin are rejected; owner approval cannot be called with a model client credential; crash recovery is explicit. No listening on a public interface.

## Handoff

Record actual commands, outputs, dependency versions, baseline commit, untested environments, and the next action. Use `docs/HANDOFF_TEMPLATE.md`.

title: [T003] WASI executor with enforceable limits

# T003 — WASI executor with enforceable limits

Status: READY
Dependencies: none

## Goal

Add a genuine isolated runtime before accepting arbitrary third-party tools. Implement explicit input mounts, no default network, memory/fuel/deadline limits, output limits and cancellation.

## Edit boundaries

* `src/dscc/executors/`
* `tests/test_sandbox.py`
* `docs/RUNTIME_MATRIX.md`

Coordinate any shared-core or protocol change through an ADR.

## Acceptance

Adversarial module cannot read a secret outside mounts, open a network connection, exceed configured memory or loop indefinitely. Tests fail closed if the runtime is absent. Never fall back to subprocess shell execution.

# T005 — Explicit peer invitations and artifact transport

Status: READY
Dependencies: none

## Goal

Implement opt-in transport for the existing signed bundle profile, with a Kubo/libp2p adapter or reviewed alternative. Pin peer identities and separate storage retrieval from compute permission.

* `src/dscc/transports/`
* `tests/test_transport.py`

Two real PCs exchange the same CID, altered blocks are rejected, untrusted signers require consent, nodes may leave, no central store is required. Local tests cannot be reported as internet/NAT tests.
